landmarks.source: Four-layer side canopies observed in reference 113, 117 and 121 seconds. Each group follows its actual mapped garage wing instead of the empty courtyard in the compound bounding rectangle. Layer spacing, overhang and heights remain visual estimates. The lowest fin clears the existing 11 m office roof.
